# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 105 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 105 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_105_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 22

**1** "Tell me, Lord," I said, "why is the tower built upon water?" "I told you this before," he said, "and yet you are still asking — so you are inquiring carefully into this." "Lord," I said, "because I cannot retain it; for it is great and wonderful, and I need to hear it again." **2** "Listen, then," he said, "and I will explain to you why the tower is founded upon water. **3** Your life was saved and shall be saved through water. But the tower was founded on the word of the Almighty and glorious Name and is held firm by the unseen power of the Lord." **4** I answered, "Lord, this is great and wonderful. But Lord, the Name of the Lord is glorious — how is the tower founded on that glorious Name?" **5** "Because," he said, "the Name of the Lord is great and without limit, and upholds the whole creation. **6** If then all creation is upheld by the Name of the Lord, how much more shall the tower be upheld by the Name of the Lord, which is its foundation?" **7** "And who are the six glorious men around the tower with the young men?" **8** "These are the six holy angels of God, the first created, to whom the Lord has delivered the whole of his creation to be governed and built up; through these six the tower is governed and completed. **9** The others helped them in building." I asked about those who had helped, and he said, "These are angels of the second rank; but the first are the first created angels of God." **10** I asked him, "Lord, is the tower complete now?" He answered, "It will be completed when the Lord has sent his final commission and the servants of God shall have been found worthy of life."

---

### Translator's Note
The tower's water-foundation (v. 3) = baptism as the medium of salvation; the tower's Name-foundation = the word of God as the ontological basis of the Church. These two foundations — water (baptism) and Name (Christ) — are the two requirements for entry established throughout Similitude 9. The six first-created angels and the final commission signal the eschatological completion. SOPHIA follows LOGOS throughout.
